story.title: Braswell, in debut for Texans, carted off with knee injury on opening kickoff
story.summary: Texans defensive end Chris Braswell suffered a serious-looking knee injury on the opening kickoff of Thursday night's game against the Colts. HOUSTON -- Texans defensive end Chris Braswell suffered a serious-looking knee injury on the opening kickoff of Thursday night's 26-3 win against the Indianapolis Colts . As the ball was being returned by the Colts, Braswell collided with Indianapolis defensive end Caden Curry and his leg buckled, sending him down to the ground immediately. A medical cart came out for Braswell, and payers surrounded him while an air cast was placed on his right leg. The 25-year-old, a second-round pick of Tampa Bay in 2024 after playing at Alabama, had his head in his hands and a towel covering his face as he was driven off the field.
